For a fresh citrus office/daytime scent under ₹5,000, these are practical shortlists based on current India pricing:

Option	Current price	Switching difficulty	What changes
Nautica Voyage 100ml	₹3,510–3,809	Easy	Very fresh/aquatic, light office profile; less citrus-focused. 
Blinkit
+1

Ajmal Silver Shade 100ml	₹1,200	Easy	Much more citrus-forward and affordable; sharper, synthetic opening. 
Ajmal Perfumes India

Ajmal Aristocrat 75/100ml	~₹4,000*	Moderate	More polished citrus/aromatic character; noticeably richer than Voyage. 
Ajmal Perfumes India

Practical switching: All three are EDT/EDP-style sprays, so there is essentially no application-learning curve. The real adjustment is scent profile: Voyage → aquatic/fresh, Silver Shade → bright citrus, Aristocrat → smoother/premium.

For your use case: Silver Shade is the lowest-cost experiment; Voyage is the safest fresh-office style; Aristocrat requires the biggest adjustment but feels less “generic fresh.”

*Check the exact size and live checkout price before paying.
